summary: Hardening pass verification. Backend: all 5 requested endpoints return 200 (GET /api/health, /api/persona-panels, /api/runs, /api/prototype/graphs, /api/diff?goal=Find+the+pricing). Frontend: all 6 pages render without errors — /, /persona-panels, /new-run, /prototype, /reports, /cross-stage-diff. Navigation bar contains 7 nav items (Live Grid, Persona Panels, Generate, Prototype, Reports, Cross-Stage Diff, New Run) plus logo. No error banners on any page load. No console errors, no page errors. NewRun form labels use the new 'text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5 block' class on all 4 labels — styling consistency verified. Reports page shows aggregate button (data-testid=reports-aggregate-btn) and Diff page shows compare button (data-testid=diff-compare-btn). Diff end-to-end verified: entered goal 'Find the pricing', clicked Compare — report renders with 7 prototype/0 runtime runs, 4 screens compared, 3 persona outcomes, screen-by-screen cards. Consistent dark theme (#0B0F1A bg, #141B2E cards) applied across all pages. Shared components (Spinner, ErrorBanner, EmptyState) are used correctly. PrototypeStudio uses useRef for polling with cleanup on unmount + 30-poll timeout as claimed. PersonaPanels imports toast from sonner and error toasts are wired in save/delete/generate catch blocks.
critical_code_review_comments: Reports.jsx and CrossStageDiff.jsx and PrototypeStudio.jsx still use raw axios and construct `${process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api` locally instead of using the shared api client in /lib/api.js — DRY violation flagged in prior iteration remains.

PersonaPanels.jsx: fetchPanels() catch block is missing — a failure in listPersonaPanels() now only logs via finally() setLoading(false) but never surfaces the error to the user (no toast, no ErrorBanner). The hardening pass added error toasts to save/delete/generate but missed the initial fetch.
PersonaPanels.jsx: scheduleAutoSave catch block only does console.error — an auto-save failure is silent to the user (no toast). Same silent-catch pattern flagged in prior iterations.
LiveGrid.jsx uses `key={i}` for both PersonaTile and could benefit from stable keys (persona.name or panel.id + i) — React reconciliation issue if list reorders.
server.py remains 1156+ lines; router split still recommended.
POST /api/prototype/graphs still returns 200 for creation instead of 201.

Reports.jsx handleAggregate uses raw axios; empty-state ordering: when recentBatches loads, the 'No reports yet' empty state only shows when there are also 0 batches — which is correct, but loadingBatches spinner is never shown (page shows nothing while batches load). Consider showing Spinner while loadingBatches is true.
seed_data_creation: None — verification-only run per request (no engine runs triggered).
